requirements.title: PWM_OUT must emit all three TC18 Table 42 trigger signals, not just exec-done
requirements.text: A PWM_OUT endpoint's trigger events shall distinguish TC18's three mandated trigger signal numbers: signal 0 (PWM request exec done -- requested values applied), signal 1 (at the start of the cycle), and signal 2 (in the middle of the active pulse, even when duty cycle is 0%). Signal 1 exists so other PWM_OUT endpoints can create phase-correlated signals; signal 2 exists so e.g. ADC endpoints can synchronize sampling to the active phase of this endpoint's waveform.
requirements.gap: Confirmed absent (2026-08-07): pwm/endpoint.go's TriggerKind enum has exactly one PWM_OUT-relevant value, TriggerOutputUpdated, fired whenever a write request changes the applied waveform (endpoint.go:300) -- this roughly maps to TC18's signal 0 (exec-done) but is not distinguished as signal 0 specifically. There is no signal-numbered event at all, and signals 1 (start-of-cycle) and 2 (mid-active-pulse) are entirely absent -- these are genuine periodic, waveform-synchronized hardware/simulation-timer events (they must fire once per PWM cycle / once per pulse midpoint regardless of whether any write request ever occurs), fundamentally different in kind from a request-driven config-change event, and cannot be synthesized from HandleRequest's existing write-triggered logic. Implementing this requires the endpoint to model real waveform-cycle timing, not just request/response state.
